commands.summary: Plan and execute the create check reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: creates a new Pingdom uptime check (this action models the common HTTP-type check shape; Pingdom's other 8 check types share the same name/host/type/paused/resolution/notification fields plus type-specific attributes not modeled here, see docs.md Known limits); low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create contact reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: creates a new alerting contact with email/SMS notification targets; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create maintenance reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: creates a new maintenance window that suppresses alerting for the assigned checks during the scheduled period; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create team reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: creates a new alerting team from a list of contact ids; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete check reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: permanently deletes an uptime check and its historical results; destructive external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete contact reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: permanently deletes an alerting contact and its notification targets; destructive external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete maintenance reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: permanently deletes a maintenance window, immediately resuming alerting for its assigned checks; destructive external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete team reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: permanently deletes an alerting team; destructive external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

Plan and execute the update check reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: updates an existing check's settings (name/host/paused/resolution/tags); external mutation, approval required

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update contact reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: updates an existing alerting contact's name/paused state/notification targets (Pingdom's PUT is a full replacement, requiring name/paused/notification_targets together); external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update team reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: updates an existing alerting team's name/member list; external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags
